verdict.rationale: Dialpad's API docs show that transcripts and AI data are stored against individual calls: an endpoint removes "transcripts, and AI data from the specified calls" while keeping the call record. That implies transcripts are attached to the conversation, but AI summaries are never named. The evidence only shows this indirectly, through deletion and anonymization endpoints. missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI call summaries, a description of how transcripts and summaries appear on the call or conversation record, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, calls get AI summaries and transcripts attached to the conversation

citations.quote: Removes call recordings, screen recordings, transcripts, and AI data from the specified calls. The call records themselves are preserved.
Call recordings and AI data associated with these contacts are also removed.
